title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Smoother editor during large git operations
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.33.2 fixes a stall where large git operations could freeze editor responsiveness while the file watcher processed a burst of changes.

highlights.title: Extension Host Responsiveness Fix
highlights.description: Fixed the file watcher overwhelming VS Code's extension host during large git operations such as checkouts and branch switches, which could make the editor sluggish while many files changed at once.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Fixed a stall where a burst of file changes during git checkouts, branch switches, or pulls could saturate the extension host, keeping VS Code responsive instead of freezing while Kotlin Jump's file watcher caught up.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No other functional changes to extension behavior in this release.
